questions.prompt: The general, present in the camp, gives rewards to the brave soldiers.
questions.answer: Dux, in castrīs praesēns, praemia mīlitibus fortibus dat.

questions.prompt: We give thanks to the gods because they hear those who pray.
questions.answer: Deīs grātiās damus quod audiunt eōs quī ōrant.

questions.prompt: While the enemy press the walls, the citizens gave water to the wounded.
questions.answer: Dum hostēs mūrōs urguent, cīvēs aquam vulnerātīs dabant.

questions.prompt: You give a fitting gift to the guest whom you love.
questions.answer: Dōnum aequum hospitī quem amās dās.

questions.prompt: Tomorrow I shall give the letters to the messenger setting out for Rome.
questions.answer: Crās epistulās nūntiō Rōmam proficīscentī dabō.

questions.prompt: If you finish the work, the master will give you liberty.
questions.answer: Sī opus fīniēs, dominus tibi lībertātem dabit.

questions.prompt: We shall give food to the poor who are begging at the gates.
questions.answer: Cibum pauperibus quī ad portās ōrant dabimus.

questions.prompt: The powerful queen will give arms to those seeking help.
questions.answer: Rēgīna potēns arma auxilium petentibus dabit.

questions.prompt: The soldiers gave their lives for the fatherland.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs vītās prō patriā dedērunt.

questions.prompt: When she had given the signal, the ships set out from the harbor.
questions.answer: Cum signum dedisset, nāvēs ē portū profectae sunt.

questions.prompt: I gave the book to the boy who was eager to learn.
questions.answer: Librum puerō discere cupientī dedī.

questions.prompt: Let us give aid to the citizens whose homes the fire has destroyed.
questions.answer: Auxilium cīvibus quōrum domōs ignis dēlēvit dēmus.

questions.prompt: The king ordered that gifts be given to the envoys.
questions.answer: Rēx imperāvit ut dōna lēgātīs darentur.

questions.prompt: If you had given me the money, I would have bought a horse.
questions.answer: Sī mihi pecūniam dedissēs, equum ēmissem.

questions.prompt: We came so that we might give a reward to the faithful servant.
questions.answer: Vēnimus ut praemium servō fidēlī darēmus.

questions.prompt: Give me your hand, friend, and do not be afraid!
questions.answer: Dā mihi manum, amīce, et nōlī timēre!

questions.prompt: Give the weapons to the men, soldiers!
questions.answer: Date arma virīs, mīlitēs!

questions.prompt: It is the duty of a good citizen to give help to the fatherland.
questions.answer: Bonī cīvis officium est patriae auxilium dare.

questions.prompt: They say that the gods gave many good things to men.
questions.answer: Dīcunt deōs multa bona hominibus dedisse.

questions.prompt: The girl giving flowers to her mother was smiling.
questions.answer: Puella mātrī flōrēs dāns rīdēbat.

questions.prompt: We are about to give a great feast to our friends.
questions.answer: Amīcīs nostrīs magnum convīvium datūrī sumus.

questions.prompt: The art of giving is difficult, but glorious.
questions.answer: Ars dandī difficilis est, sed glōriōsa.

questions.prompt: The mother gave milk to the crying infant.
questions.answer: Māter īnfantī flentī lac dedit.

questions.prompt: Having steered the ship through the storm, the helmsman gave a signal to the frightened crew.
questions.answer: Gubernātor, nāve per tempestātem gubernātā, sociīs trepidīs signum dedit.

questions.prompt: The stars give light to the travelers wandering in the dark night.
questions.answer: Stēllae lūmen viātōribus in nocte obscūrā errantibus dant.

questions.prompt: You will give a just punishment to the enemy who inflicted so great an injury.
questions.answer: Poenam iūstam hostī dabis quī tantam iniūriam intulit.

questions.prompt: Although we had given many gifts, the greedy man demanded more.
questions.answer: Quamquam multa dōna dederāmus, avārus plūra poposcit.

questions.prompt: The brave woman gives her hand to the trembling boy so that he may not be afraid.
questions.answer: Fēmina fortis manum puerō trementī dat nē timeat.

questions.prompt: If the general had given the signal earlier, the wounded would have been saved.
questions.answer: Sī dux signum mātūrius dedisset, vulnerātī servātī essent.

questions.prompt: The art of giving well delights both the giver and the one receiving.
questions.answer: Ars bene dandī et datōrem et accipientem dēlectat.

questions.prompt: When you have given the reward, the glad soldiers will return to the camp.
questions.answer: Cum praemium dederis, mīlitēs laetī in castra redībunt.
